Questions 1–10

Complete the notes below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

Name: Luisa
Address: White Stone Rd
Postcode:
Occupation:
Reason for visit to town: to go to the
Suggestions for improvement:
better
have more footpaths
more frequent
having parking places for bicycles
being able to use a at work
the opportunity to have cycling on busy roads

transcript.en: I wonder if you could spare a few minutes to do a survey on transport. It won't take long.
transcript.zh: 我想问您能不能抽几分钟时间帮我们做一个关于交通工具的调查，不会耽误您很长时间的。

transcript.en: The survey is on behalf of the local council.
transcript.zh: 我们是代表当地市政府来做这项调查的。

transcript.en: They'd like to know about what transport you use and any suggestions for improvement.
transcript.zh: 他们想知道您使用的是哪种交通工具，还有您有什么改善交通的建议吗？

transcript.en: Can I start by asking you how you travelled to town today?
transcript.zh: 我能不能先问问您今天是怎么来到市里的？

transcript.en: Sure. I came on the bus.
transcript.zh: 当然可以，我是坐公交车来的。

transcript.en: Now can I get a few details about yourself?
transcript.zh: 现在您能不能告诉我一些您的个人信息？

transcript.en: Great. Thanks. And can I have your address?
transcript.zh: 很好，多谢。您能说一下您的住址吗？

transcript.en: Oh, right. I know that area. It's Bradfield, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 啊，我知道那个地方，是在Bradfield，对吗？没错。

transcript.en: Great. And could I ask what your job is?
transcript.zh: 很好，您介意我问一下您是从事什么工作的吗？

transcript.en: I've actually just finished my training. I'm a hairdresser.
transcript.zh: 事实上我刚刚完成培训，我是个美发师。

transcript.en: And one more question in this section.
transcript.zh: 这部分还有最后一个问题

transcript.en: What is the reason for you coming into town today?
transcript.zh: 您今天进城的原因是什么呢？

transcript.en: Actually it's not for shopping today, which would be my normal reason but to see the dentist.
transcript.zh: 实际上我一般进城都是为了购物，不过今天不是，今天是来看牙医的。

transcript.en: Now in this last section I'd like you to give us some ideas about the facilities and arrangements in the city for getting to and from work, emm, any suggestions you have for improvements.
transcript.zh: 那么在这最后一部分，我希望您告诉我们一些，您在上下班的路上对于市里的一些设施和配置的想法，您有没有什么改进这些设施的建议？

transcript.en: Well, something I've thought about for some time is that when I do walk and I'm doing a later shift	 I think the lighting should be better.
transcript.zh: 我有时候想过的一件事就是，在我走路和上晚班的时候，我觉得路灯应该再亮一些。

transcript.en: And of course, I think it's a real shame they've been cutting down on the number of footpaths. They should have more of those.Then people would walk more.
transcript.zh: 还有，他们一直在缩减人行道的数量，我觉得这实在是太遗憾了。他们应该多建些人行道才对，这样人们才会多走路。

transcript.en: And, I don't think there are enough trains. That's why I don't use them - you have to wait so long.
transcript.zh: 另外，我觉得火车的数量也不够，这就是我不坐火车的原因了，因为每次都要等很久。

transcript.en: And finally I'd like to ask your opinion on cycling. As you may know	 there's a drive in the city to get more people to cycle to work.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。最后我还想问问您关于自行车的看法。您可能也知道，市里正在鼓励更多人骑自行车上班。

transcript.en: But we realise that there are things which the council, but also employers, might do to help encourage workers to cycle to work.
transcript.zh: 但是我们发现除了市政府，公司老板们也能做一些事情来帮助鼓励员工骑自行车上班。

transcript.en: Well, I have thought about it and where I work there are no safe places to leave your bikes.
transcript.zh: 我有想到过这一点。在我上班的地方，没有安全场所可以停放自行车。

transcript.en: And also	I'd have to cycle uphill and on a hot day I'd arrive at work pretty sweaty so I think I'd need a shower somewhere at work.
transcript.zh: 还有，我骑自行车的话得上坡，如果天气热，我到达工作地点的时候就已经全身是汗了，所以我觉得在公司应该有个可以冲澡的地方。

transcript.en: And I suppose the last thing is that I wouldn't be all that confident about cycling on such busy roads.
transcript.zh: 我觉得最后一件事就是，我可能对在那么繁忙的道路上骑车不是太有信心。

transcript.en: I think I'd like to see you offering training for that, you know	 I'd feel a lot better about starting if that was the case.
transcript.zh: 我觉得你们应该提供一些相关培训，这样我在那种情况下骑车会感觉好很多。
您的建议对我们很有帮助。

transcript.en: Thank you very much for your time.
transcript.zh: 非常感谢您能抽出时间来做这个调查。
